labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Usage question: asks how to strip styles from a markup string. Rich's documented way is Text.from_markup(...).plain.

body:
To get the plain text of a markup string without styles, parse it with `Text.from_markup` and read the `.plain` property: `Text.from_markup("[bold]Hello[/bold] world").plain` returns `"Hello world"`. The markup API is described in the docs page at https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst

Usage questions belong in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions), where the maintainer can convert or close them.
